Remark
[Variation of covariant derivatives] 1. ch2:3.3 Source: topping:page-0030 \group topping-background

For a fixed tensor field $A$, \[ rac{\partial }{\partial t} abla A=A* abla h, \] whereas for a time-dependent tensor field, \[ rac{\partial }{\partial t} abla A- abla rac{\partial A}{\partial t}=A* abla h. \]
